content_sections.heading: About the Recruiting School
content_sections.text: The School of Education of Pondicherry University, Puducherry, is filling this post. The guest faculty member will teach Chemistry in the school's Integrated Teacher Education Programme (ITEP), which covers the B.Sc., B.Ed. and B.A., B.Ed. courses. The notice is signed by Dr. Sreekala E, Professor and Dean, School of Education, and is dated 17 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notice does not mention which reservation category the vacancy belongs to.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: M.Sc. in Chemistry with a minimum of 55% marks B.Ed. with minimum 55% marks or equivalent grade NET or SLET or Ph.D in Education or in Chemistry M.Ed. or M.Ed. with specialization Ph.D in Education The University will consider qualifications and other conditions as per the norms of UGC-NCTE guidelines. The candidate should not be in receipt of any other Scholarship / Fellowship. The notice does not mention any experience requirement or age limit. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility for this post.

rows.desirable_qualifications: M.Ed. or M.Ed. with specialization; Ph.D in Education

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Honorarium: The guest faculty may be paid an honorarium of Rs. 1,500/- per lecture, subject to a maximum of Rs. 50,000/- per month. Tenure: The selected guest faculty will be engaged until a regular faculty member is appointed or until the end of the academic year, whichever is earlier. Nature of engagement: The engagement is a guest faculty engagement for the ITEP B.Sc., B.Ed. & B.A., B.Ed. programme in the School of Education.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Pondicherry University GUEST FACULTY for Chemistry
content_sections.text: Prepare your updated CV. Scan your certificates from 10th standard to Ph.D., your experience certificates, and a No Objection Certificate if one applies to you. Combine the CV and all scanned certificates into a single PDF file. Email the PDF to the Dean at [email protected] on or before 26 November 2026 . Attend the walk-in interview on 30 November 2026 (Monday) at 10.00 A.M. at the School of Education, Silver Jubilee Campus, Pondicherry University.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification. No separate intimation will be sent to candidates. TA/DA will not be paid for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many Guest Faculty vacancies are there for Chemistry at Pondicherry University?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Guest Faculty for Chemistry in the ITEP B.Sc., B.Ed. & B.A., B.Ed. programme of the School of Education, Pondicherry University.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to send the application?
faq.answer: Candidates must email their CV and scanned certificates to [email protected] on or before 26 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. When and where is the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 30 November 2026 (Monday) at 10.00 A.M. at the School of Education, Silver Jubilee Campus, Pondicherry University.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is required for the Guest Faculty post?
faq.answer: Candidates need an M.Sc. in Chemistry with a minimum of 55% marks, a B.Ed. with minimum 55% marks or equivalent grade, and NET or SLET or Ph.D in Education or in Chemistry. M.Ed. (or M.Ed. with specialization) and Ph.D in Education are desirable.

faq.question: Q5. What is the honorarium for the Guest Faculty post?
faq.answer: The guest faculty may be paid an honorarium of Rs. 1,500 per lecture, subject to a maximum of Rs. 50,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the Pondicherry University Guest Faculty post?
faq.answer: Send your updated CV with scanned certificates (10th standard to Ph.D., experience certificates and a No Objection Certificate if applicable) in a single PDF file to [email protected] by 26 November 2026, then attend the interview on 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q7. Is the Guest Faculty job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The engagement lasts until a regular faculty member is appointed or until the end of the academic year, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q8. What should I bring to the interview?
faq.answer: Bring your CV, a recent passport size photo, all original certificates related to educational qualifications and your community certificate, along with one set of photocopies for verification.

faq.question: Q9. Can a candidate receiving a fellowship apply?
faq.answer: The candidate should not be in receipt of any other Scholarship / Fellowship.

faq.question: Q10. Will TA/DA be paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that TA/DA will not be paid and that no separate intimation will be sent.
